lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Why the sky so blue? Why my heart feel crack?
Why they script my mind, tryna change it to the track?
Why they feed these kids, poison through a glowing screen?
Why my earliest dreams feel more real than my teens?
Why they chalk on a baby like another lost son?
Why they hashtag tears and they scroll and they run?
Why I look at my brother, see a threat, not kin
Why this world teach lose, why you talk about win
Why the lies feel safe, but the truth feel hard
Why I cover up pain, play the fearless card
Why these thoughts from the sandbox still here are
Why the scripts they wrote never matched your law
Why the sky so blue, why my heart feel crad
Why this grip my mind, tryna chain me to the track
Why the room so cold, when the hate push back
Why they have David give it to the choir director
Like that why the drums go loud when the secret's in
Why the tears in the dark got a holy grin
Why the south side cry sound just like a song
Why the storm in my chest turn to worship and come
Why the poor stay broke, why the rich talk low
Why they quote your name but they never look up
Why a child in war, why a gun in his hand
Why they profit off the blood, call it building the land
Why the suit in the tower got a shark fin smile
Why the mom on the floor pray to rent for a while
Why the food in the trash could've fed ten more?
Why a locked glass door got an empty store?
Why I sense fake love when I read this room?
Why the brightest lights hide the deepest gloom?
Why the loudest faith got the softest spine?
Why your quiet voice cut the loudest line?
Why, why, why
Why do y'all have David give it to the choir director?
Make the whole choir cry
Turn the beat to an altar Let the whole blockhead squat
Why the ones with Bibles got the sharpest knives?
Why they sacrifice hearts just to guard their lives?
Why they dress up bright and they call it right?
Why they flee over but they love that mic?
Why the mask fit tight when the hurt run deep?
Why they sleep so light when the secret's creaked?
Why the singer in me feel older than time?
Why the chains on my soul feel linked to the crime
Why I used to talk hard but it cut so deep
Why the thought of his eyes never let me sleep
Why the things in the volume to the nerve I hide
Why the truth in those lines split my heart in pride
Why the deep things whispered in the secret place
Turn a heart and face to a child in grace
Why the sky so blue, why my heart feel grand
Why they script my mind, tryna take me to the track
Why the room so cold when there ain't pushback?
Why the odd day to give it to the fire director like that?
Why the bass so heavy when conviction falls?
Why the hood feel small when your presence calls?
Why my watch don't wild but it ends in peace?
Why my war in the mirror start to find release?
Why I brag on the deep when I'm dust and bread?
Why you pull me from the script that was written for dead?
Why you send me to the block with a scrolling pen?
Why you tell me yes, why, then you heal me again?
Why my childhood questions like a loop come back
When I sit away still, let the armor crack
Why the boy that I buried just to act grown hard
Start to weep when your name hit the battle scar
Why the tears taste sweet when they fall for real
Why the wounds show light when you start to heal
Why the hardest streets still can feel your touch
Why I whisper from you overpower so much
Why, why, why
Why do y'all have David give it to the choir director
Make the pain testify
Why, why, why, why, why Open up your inner child
Leia, who's gonna meet that why? Why?
